blocks.tex:
Throughout, $n\ge3$, indices of vertices and edges lie in $\Zn$, and
$\kappa=(\kappa_i)_{i\in\Zn}$ is a \emph{profile} of prescribed curvatures.
Edge $i$ joins vertex $i$ to vertex $i+1$; it has length $\ell_i=2h_i$, and
$h_i$ is its \emph{half-length}. For $X,Y,W\in\C$ we write
$[X,Y,W]=\operatorname{Im}\bigl(\overline{(Y-X)}\,(W-X)\bigr)$ for twice the
signed area of the triangle $XYW$, and
\begin{equation}\label{eq:menger}
  M(X,Y,W)=\frac{2\,[X,Y,W]}{|X-Y|\,|Y-W|\,|W-X|}\tag{3.1}\end{equation}
for its signed Menger curvature; $|M|$ is the reciprocal circumradius.

blocks.label: def:development
blocks.title: def:development

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.closureGap
lean.code:
noncomputable def closureGap (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℂ :=
  vertexR2 κ ℓ n

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningAngle
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningAngle (K : ℝ) (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : ℝ :=
  Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) + Real.arcsin (κ i * tK K (ℓ i / 2))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.turningSum
lean.code:
noncomputable def turningSum [NeZero n] (κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : ZMod n, turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i

blocks.tex:
Both $\Gap$ and $\Turn$ are real-analytic in $(\kappa,h)$ on the open set
where $h\in D_\kappa$, including where some $h_i$ vanish. For moderate $h$
and $\kappa>0$ both arcsines in~\eqref{eq:turning-law} lie in $(0,\pi/2)$, so
$\theta_i\in(0,\pi)$.

blocks.label: lem:tangent-chord
blocks.title: Tangent--chord
blocks.body:
Let $\kappa>0$ and let $h$ be moderate. Then
$M(P_k,P_{k+1},P_{k+2})=\kappa_{k+1}$ for every $k\in\mathbb N$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.signedMengerR2_development
lean.code:
theorem signedMengerR2_development {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ} (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    signedMengerR2 (vertexR2 κ ℓ k) (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1))
        (vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1)) = κ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
  -- the two edge vectors of the middle triple
  have hu : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ k
      = (ℓ (k : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ k : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  have hw : vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1 + 1) - vertexR2 κ ℓ (k + 1)
      = (ℓ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) : ℂ)
          * Complex.exp ((heading κ ℓ (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [vertexR2_succ]; ring
  set i : ZMod n := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) with hi
  set a : ℝ := ℓ (k : ZMod n) with ha
  set b : ℝ := ℓ i with hb
  set α : ℝ := heading κ ℓ k with hαd
  set β : ℝ := heading κ ℓ (k + 1) with hβd
  set θ : ℝ := turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i with hθd
  rw [signedMengerR2_of_diffs hu hw]
  -- turning-angle relation β - α = θ
  have hθ : β - α = θ := by
    rw [hβd, heading_succ, ← hi, ← hθd, ← hαd]; ring
  -- edge components and norms
  rw [edge_re, edge_im, edge_re, edge_im]
  have hapos : 0 < a := h.length_pos (k : ZMod n)
  have hbpos : 0 < b := h.length_pos i
  -- the third side is the vertex chord
  have hnorm : ‖(a : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      + (b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((β : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = vertexChord κ ℓ i := by
    rw [Complex.norm_eq_sqrt_sq_add_sq, vertexChord]
    congr 1
    have hi1 : i - 1 = (k : ZMod n) := by rw [hi]; push_cast; ring
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, edge_re, edge_im]
    rw [hi1, ← ha, ← hb, ← hθd, ← hθ, Real.cos_sub]
    linear_combination a ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq α
      + b ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq β
  rw [edge_norm, edge_norm, abs_of_pos hapos, abs_of_pos hbpos, hnorm]
  -- final algebra through the Menger chord identity
  have hmenger : κ i * vertexChord κ ℓ i = 2 * Real.sin θ := by
    have := menger_chord_identity h i
    rwa [← hθd] at this
  have hvc := vertexChord_pos h i
  have hnum : a * Real.cos α * (b * Real.sin β) - a * Real.sin α * (b * Real.cos β)
      = a * b * Real.sin θ := by
    rw [← hθ, Real.sin_sub]; ring
  rw [hnum, show 2 * (a * b * Real.sin θ) = a * b * (2 * Real.sin θ) from by ring,
    ← hmenger]
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hapos
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hbpos
  have hvc0 : vertexChord κ ℓ i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hvc
  field_simp

/-! ## Menger realizability and the forward bridge -/

blocks.tex:
Put $i=k+1$, $a=\ell_{i-1}$, $b=\ell_i$, $X=\arcsin(\kappa_ia/2)$ and
$Y=\arcsin(\kappa_ib/2)$, so $\theta_i=X+Y$ and $X,Y\in(0,\pi/2)$. The edges
at $P_i$ are $u=ae^{\ii\psi}$ and $w=be^{\ii(\psi+\theta_i)}$ with
$\psi=\psi_{i-1}$. Hence $[P_{i-1},P_i,P_{i+1}]=\operatorname{Im}(\bar
uw)=ab\sin\theta_i$ and, substituting $a=2\sin X/\kappa_i$, $b=2\sin
Y/\kappa_i$,
\[
  \tfrac{\kappa_i^2}{4}|P_{i+1}-P_{i-1}|^2
  =\sin^2\!X+\sin^2\!Y+2\sin X\sin Y\cos(X+Y)=\sin^2(X+Y).
\]
So $\kappa_i|P_{i+1}-P_{i-1}|=2\sin\theta_i$ and
$M=2ab\sin\theta_i/(ab\,|P_{i+1}-P_{i-1}|)=\kappa_i$.

If $\Gap(\kappa,h)=0$ and $\Turn(\kappa,h)=2\pi$, then $\psi_{j+n}=\psi_j+2\pi$,
so $\ell_{k+n}e^{\ii\psi_{k+n}}=\ell_ke^{\ii\psi_k}$ and, by induction,
$P_{k+n}=P_k$. The development then descends to a closed polygon
$(P_i)_{i\in\Zn}$.

blocks.label: def:realization
blocks.title: def:realization
blocks.body:
Let $\kappa\in\R^n$ be positive. Half-lengths $h$ \emph{realize} $\kappa$ if
$h$ is moderate, $\Gap(\kappa,h)=0$ and $\Turn(\kappa,h)=2\pi$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RealizesR2
lean.code:
def RealizesR2 [NeZero n] (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ, ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ ∧ closureGap κ ℓ = 0 ∧
    turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi ∧ IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ)

/-! ## The constant profile closes -/

blocks.label: prop:convex
blocks.title: prop:convex
blocks.body:
If $h$ realizes $\kappa$, then $[P_a,P_{a+1},P_c]>0$ whenever
$c\notin\{a,a+1\}$. In particular the polygon $(P_i)_{i\in\Zn}$ is simple and
strictly convex.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos
lean.code:
theorem crossR2_polygonR2_edge_vertex_pos [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi)
    (a c : ZMod n) (hca : c ≠ a) (hca1 : c ≠ a + 1) :
    0 < crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ a) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (a + 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ c) := by
  have hleft := support_pos_cyclic h hκ hE hT a c hca hca1
  rw [polygonR2_edgeVector hE hT, crossR2_edgeVector]
  exact mul_pos (h.length_pos a) hleft

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive
lean.code:
theorem isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 κ ℓ) :=
  ⟨fun i => polygonR2_edge_ne h hE hT i,
   fun i => polygonR2_consecutive_inter h hκ hE hT hn i,
   fun i j hij hij1 hji1 => polygonR2_nonadjacent_disjoint h hκ hE hT i j hij hij1 hji1⟩

deps.title: Positive one-turn polygons have strict edge support
deps.label: detail:discrete-edge-support

blocks.tex:
Since every $\theta_i>0$ and $\psi_{j+n}=\psi_j+2\pi$, we have
$\psi_k<\psi_m<\psi_k+2\pi$ for $k<m<k+n$. Fix $k$. For $k\le j$,
\begin{equation}\label{eq:support}
  \operatorname{Im}\bigl(e^{-\ii\psi_k}(P_j-P_k)\bigr)
  =\sum_{m=k}^{j-1}\ell_m\sin(\psi_m-\psi_k),\tag{3.5}\end{equation}
and the full sum over $k\le m<k+n$ vanishes. Let $k+1<j<k+n$. If
$\psi_{j-1}-\psi_k\le\pi$, every term in~\eqref{eq:support} is $\ge0$ and the
term $m=k+1$ is $\ell_{k+1}\sin\theta_{k+1}>0$. Otherwise
$\psi_m-\psi_k\in(\pi,2\pi)$ for $j\le m<k+n$, and~\eqref{eq:support} equals
$-\sum_{m=j}^{k+n-1}\ell_m\sin(\psi_m-\psi_k)>0$. Either way
$[P_k,P_{k+1},P_j]>0$. So every vertex off an edge lies in the open left
half-plane of that edge; two non-adjacent edges are separated by the line of
one of them, and consecutive edges meet only in their common vertex.

A polygon is \emph{coherent} if for every $i$ the triple
$P_{i-1},P_i,P_{i+1}$ is non-collinear and its circumcenter $O_i$ lies in
the open vertex cone
$\{P_i+s(P_{i-1}-P_i)+t(P_{i+1}-P_i):s,t>0\}$.

blocks.label: prop:coherent
blocks.title: prop:coherent
blocks.body: If $h$ realizes $\kappa$, the polygon $(P_i)_{i\in\Zn}$ is coherent.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.coherent_development_moderate
lean.code:
theorem coherent_development_moderate [NeZero n] {κ ℓ : ZMod n → ℝ}
    (h : ModerateArc 0 κ ℓ) (hκ : ∀ i : ZMod n, 0 < κ i)
    (hE : closureGap κ ℓ = 0) (hT : turningSum κ ℓ = 2 * Real.pi) :
    CoherentR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ) := by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨ψ, ψ', hd, hem, hep⟩ := polygon_edges hE hT i
  have hl1 := h.length_pos (i - 1)
  have hl2 := h.length_pos i
  have hκi := hκ i
  have hθpos : 0 < turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i := turningAngle_pos h hκi
  have hθlt : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i < Real.pi := by
    have := abs_turningAngle_lt_pi h i
    rw [abs_lt] at this
    exact this.2
  have hsinθ : 0 < Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθpos hθlt
  have hprod := conj_edge_mul_edge hE hT i
  have hre_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).re
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.cos (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]
  have him_eq : ((starRingEnd ℂ) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)
        * (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i)).im
      = -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) := by
    rw [hprod, Complex.im_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
  have hcross : crossR2 (polygonR2 κ ℓ i) (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1))
      (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [crossR2_eq_im_conj_mul, him_eq]
    have : -(ℓ (i - 1) * ℓ i) * Real.sin (turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i) < 0 := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hl1 hl2) hsinθ]
    exact ne_of_lt this
  refine ⟨hcross, ?_⟩
  set A := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2)) with hA
  set B := Real.arcsin (κ i * (ℓ i / 2)) with hB
  have hθAB : turningAngle 0 κ ℓ i = A + B := by
    rw [turningAngle, hA, hB, tK_zero, tK_zero]
  have hargl : κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_left i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargr : κ i * (ℓ i / 2) < 1 := by
    have := h.wall_right i
    rwa [tK_zero, abs_of_pos hκi] at this
  have hargl0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl1)
  have hargr0 : 0 < κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := mul_pos hκi (half_pos hl2)
  have hsinA : Real.sin A = κ i * (ℓ (i - 1) / 2) := by
    rw [hA]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargl.le
  have hsinB : Real.sin B = κ i * (ℓ i / 2) := by
    rw [hB]; exact Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hargr.le
  have hcosA : 0 < Real.cos A := by
    rw [hA, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have hcosB : 0 < Real.cos B := by
    rw [hB, Real.cos_arcsin]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith)
  have htrig := neg_sin_mul_cos_add_lt (hsinA ▸ hargl0) (hsinB ▸ hargr0)
    hcosA hcosB (by rw [← hθAB]; exact hsinθ)
  rw [hsinA, hsinB, lt_min_iff] at htrig
  have hnu : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i - 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ (i - 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hem, Complex.normSq_neg, normSq_scaled_exp]
  have hnw : normSq (polygonR2 κ ℓ (i + 1) - polygonR2 κ ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ 2 := by
  -- … (truncated)

deps.title: Moderate arcs give coherence and exact Menger curvature
deps.label: detail:discrete-coherence

blocks.tex:
Fix $i$, write $u=P_{i-1}-P_i$, $w=P_{i+1}-P_i$, and let $a,b,X,Y$ be as in
the proof of \ref{lem:tangent-chord}. Then $\bar uw=-ab\,e^{\ii\theta_i}$,
so $\delta=\operatorname{Im}(\bar uw)=-ab\sin\theta_i\ne0$ and
$\mathcal{C}=\operatorname{Re}(\bar uw)=-ab\cos\theta_i$. The circumcenter is
$O_i=P_i+su+tw$ with
$s=|w|^2(|u|^2-\mathcal C)/(2\delta^2)$ and
$t=|u|^2(|w|^2-\mathcal C)/(2\delta^2)$: indeed
$\langle su+tw,u\rangle=|u|^2(|u|^2|w|^2-\mathcal C^2)/(2\delta^2)=|u|^2/2$,
and likewise for $w$. So $O_i$ lies in the open cone if and only if
$\mathcal C<\min(|u|^2,|w|^2)$. Now
\[
  a^2-\mathcal C=\tfrac{4}{\kappa_i^2}\sin X\bigl(\sin X+\sin Y\cos(X+Y)\bigr)
  =\tfrac{4}{\kappa_i^2}\sin X\sin(X+Y)\cos Y>0,
\]
since $X,Y\in(0,\pi/2)$; the moderate-arc inequalities are used exactly here,
to get $\cos Y>0$. The inequality $b^2-\mathcal C>0$ is symmetric.

blocks.label: lem:paper-constant
blocks.title: Constant profile
blocks.body:
If $\kappa\equiv c>0$, then $h_i=\sin(\pi/n)/c$ realizes $\kappa$: every
$\theta_i=2\pi/n$, and the polygon is the regular $n$-gon.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.realizesR2_const
lean.code:
theorem realizesR2_const [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    RealizesR2 (fun _ : ZMod n => c) := by
  obtain ⟨hMA, _, hsum, hclose⟩ := regularGon_closes hn hc
  exact ⟨fun _ => 2 / c * Real.sin (Real.pi / n), hMA, hclose, hsum,
    isSimplePolygon_of_turningPositive hn hMA (fun _ => hc) hclose hsum⟩

blocks.label: def:dfv
blocks.title: def:dfv
blocks.body:
A profile $\kappa\in\R^n$ has a \emph{strict four-vertex window} at level
$c\in\R$, written $\DFV(\kappa,c)$, if there are integers
$i_1<i_2<i_3<i_4<i_1+n$ satisfying~\eqref{eq:dfv}, indices read mod $n$. A
\emph{plateau maximum run} of $\kappa$ is a cyclic interval
$I=\{a,\dots,a+k\}$ with $k<n-1$ on which $\kappa$ is constant, such that
$\kappa_{a-1}<\kappa_a>\kappa_{a+k+1}$; plateau minimum runs are defined
with the inequalities reversed.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV
lean.code:
def DFV (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i₁ i₂ i₃ i₄ : ℕ, i₁ < i₂ ∧ i₂ < i₃ ∧ i₃ < i₄ ∧ i₄ < i₁ + n ∧
    c < κ ((i₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c ∧
    c < κ ((i₃ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₄ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DiscreteFourVertexPos

blocks.tex:
A window forces $n\ge4$ and, for $\kappa>0$, $c>0$. The runs are the
plateau extrema of \ref{sec:intro}: the strict drops at both ends
force maximality.

blocks.label: lem:dfv-plateau
blocks.title: lem:dfv-plateau

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.discreteFourVertexPos_iff_extrema
lean.code:
theorem discreteFourVertexPos_iff_extrema [NeZero n] {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} :
    DiscreteFourVertexPos κ ↔ DiscreteFourVertexExtrema κ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hconst | ⟨c, -, hdfv⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨hpos, Or.inl hconst⟩
    · exact ⟨hpos, Or.inr ⟨hdfv.plateau_extrema.1, hdfv.plateau_extrema.2⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpos, hconst | ⟨hmax, -⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨hpos, Or.inl hconst⟩
    · obtain ⟨c, hdfv⟩ := exists_dfv_of_two_plateauMaxRun hmax
      exact ⟨hpos, Or.inr ⟨c, hdfv.pos_of_pos hpos, hdfv⟩⟩

deps.title: the level form and the extremum form define the same class
deps.label: thm:tab_pos_iff_extrema

blocks.tex:
(a)$\Rightarrow$(b),(c). On the integer interval $[i_4-n,i_2]$ the endpoints
are $<c<\kappa_{i_1}$, so a maximum of $\kappa$ on it is attained at an
interior point, and the maximal run of equal values through that point lies
strictly inside the interval. This is a plateau maximum run in
$(i_4-n,i_2)$. The interval $[i_2,i_4]$ gives a disjoint one in
$(i_2,i_4)$. The minimum runs come from $[i_1,i_3]$ and $[i_3,i_1+n]$.

(b)$\Rightarrow$(a). Let $I_1=\{a,\dots,a+k\}$ and $I_2$ be disjoint
plateau maximum runs with values $v_1\le v_2$, and let $a+j$, $0\le j<n$, be
the initial point of $I_2$. Then $j>k$, and $j\ne k+1$, $j\ne n-1$, since
otherwise a strict drop at an end of $I_1$ would give $v_2<v_1$. For $c$
strictly between $\max(\kappa_{a-1},\kappa_{a+k+1})$ and $v_1$, the indices
$a<a+k+1<a+j<a+n-1$ form a window. Apply this to $-\kappa$ for (c).

Inversion $r\mapsto1/r$ exchanges plateau maxima and minima. So the
hypothesis of \ref{thm:main} says exactly that $\kappa=1/r$ has a
strict four-vertex window at some level $c>0$.

deps.title: every positive DFV word is realized
deps.label: thm:four_active_realizes_dfv

blocks.tex:
\textbf{Proof of \ref{thm:main}.} 
Let $\kappa=1/r$ and let $h$ be a realization from
\ref{thm:dfv-realizes}, with closed polygon $P$. The polygon is
simple and strictly convex by \ref{prop:convex}, and coherent by
\ref{prop:coherent}. \ref{lem:tangent-chord} and periodicity
give $M(P_{i-1},P_i,P_{i+1})=\kappa_i$, hence the prescribed circumradii.
For the stated local non-concyclicity consequence, if
$P_{i-1},P_i,P_{i+1},P_{i+2}$ lie on a circle with center $O$, then $O$ is the
circumcenter of both non-collinear triples
$P_{i-1},P_i,P_{i+1}$ and $P_i,P_{i+1},P_{i+2}$, so $r_i=|OP_i|=r_{i+1}$.
